notes.title: 🔥 New ILA Demo in the Making! Explore New Areas & Gameplay!
notes.content:
Hi everyone!! 💜

We’ve got exciting development news and a brand-new demo to share with you!!! ✨


[h3]🥁 [b]Steam Next Fest & New Demo Launch![/b][/h3]

Let’s start with the big news: [b]we’re participating in Steam Next Fest![/b]

🗓️ [b]June 9th to 16th[/b]

Starting next Monday and running through June 16th, you’ll be able to enjoy a [b]brand-new demo[/b], featuring a cozy and mysterious new area of the island with a small taste of what’s to come in the final game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45045030/ecbd315d4df8489cbdd61d77a6aa01bd28a13e29.gif[/img]

We poured so much love into this space, it's a team favorite, and we’re so excited for you to explore it 💫


[h3]🎮 [b]Development Update: Beyond Alpha![/b][/h3]

Last month, we completed the [b]Alpha[/b], and this month we’ve been diving into [b]finalizing the art[/b], polishing gameplay, and making sure ILA feels alive and magical.

Here’s a peek at what we’ve been working on:

✨ Gameplay and puzzle improvements

✨ New (and super cool) Ila animations

✨ Environmental detailing across the island

✨ Even more story magic to make exploring feel meaningful and mysterious

Everything’s starting to come together beautifully and we can’t wait for you to play it!


[h3]🎁 [b]New Customization Items Added to the Final Game![/b][/h3]

We can’t wait for you to see all the amazing customization clothes the final game will include! Unfortunately, these aren’t available in the demo, but we wanted to share a little sneak peek at our latest additions. 

We’ve recently finished some [b]fun and magical new customization items[/b] to the final game, and we hope they’ll bring even more personality to your journey through the island:

🌀 [b]The Wind Hat[/b] & 🖤 [b]The Inkycap Hat[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45045030/cc5843b0daaee9a3c877b67060b7ccbea5b9fa5d.png[/img]

🐸 [b]The Froggy Hat & Cape[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45045030/d9fa8edc49027bc767f022c80ee307d717f31352.png[/img]

They’re weird, whimsical, and 100% magical. We can’t wait to see how you style your Ila! 💜


[h3][b]🎥 New Trailer & Steam Event![/b][/h3]

ILA will also be featured tomorrow in the [b]Women-Led Games Showcase[/b] as part of [b]Summer Game Fest 2025[/b], and we’ll be premiering a [b]brand-new trailer[/b]! 🌟

📅 [b]June 7th, 10AM PT / 1PM ET / 19:00 CET[/b]

📺 Watch it on [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=LsDFjNW8jhA]YouTube[/url] or [url=https://www.twitch.tv/womenledgames]Twitch[/url]:


[h3][b]🌟 Don't Forget to Wishlist![/b][/h3]

If you love what you see but haven’t wishlisted ILA yet, now’s the perfect time to do it! Wishlisting helps more people discover the game and ensures you don’t miss a thing.


Thanks for following ILA’s journey and being a part of our growing community! We can’t wait to hear what you think of the new demo. And as always, your support means the world to us 💜

With love,
[b]The Magic Rain Team 🩵[/b]

notes.title: Kickstarter Success + What’s Next! 🥳
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45045030/b2d64ba882cbc044c13172faaba86fffa6a28a9e.png[/img]

[h3]ILA: A Frosty Glide is officially happening! 🚀[/h3]

We still can’t believe it! 🤍 Our Kickstarter campaign has come to an end, and we’ve raised €26,363 so far thanks to 678 incredible backers! 🎉 Your support has been truly amazing, and we are beyond grateful to have such a wonderful community behind us.

The Kickstarter will remain open for a few more hours for anyone who missed it!

From the bottom of our hearts, [b]THANK YOU! 🩵[/b] This was our very first Kickstarter, and we’re amazed to have so many of you as part of ILA’s story. Your encouragement, feedback, and excitement mean the world to us, and we’re putting all our love and effort into making this game the best experience possible!


[h3]Kickstarter Unlocks! 🎁[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45045030/b353a37c1cad1fbf33f4fa2ece1d6fcb53b1aafe.gif[/img]

Thanks to your amazing support, [b]we’ve unlocked some fantastic extras that will make ILA even more magical! ✨[/b]

[b]🔥 Special Fire Outfit + Fire Skatebroom & ❄️ Ice Outfit[/b] – ILA will now have stylish themed outfits and matching skatebrooms!

[b]🛹 Sit & Relax Anywhere Emote[/b] – Take a break, sit on your skatebroom, and enjoy the view anytime. A cozy moment just for you!

[b]🧙‍♀️Community Hats & Capes[/b] – Our amazing Discord community helped choose beautiful new hats and capes for ILA, and [b]we plan to keep creating and voting on even more designs together! Join us in shaping the game’s customization options in our Discord channel![/b]

💬 Join our Discord: https://discord.gg/VwhC9FKdvk


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45045030/97e94bff14ef94eadf3556dc10b9af3da82b0e32.png[/img]


[h3]What’s Next? Development Continues![/h3]

With the campaign wrapped up, we’re now focusing on the next big steps:

🌟 Continuing to develop and improve the game based on all the feedback we received
🌟 Bringing to life the amazing rewards and extras we unlocked
🌟 Collaborating with our Kickstarter co-designers to create unique in-game content
🌟 Producing and shipping physical rewards for our backers

🚨 [b]To fully focus on development, we will be taking down the demo later today. This will allow us to improve and refine the game based on all the wonderful feedback we’ve received.[/b]

We can’t wait to share our progress with you!


[h3]Join the Community & Help Shape ILA! 💜[/h3]

The Kickstarter may be over, but the adventure continues! [b]We’ll be hosting more community votes, sharing development updates, and discussing fun ideas in our Discord. Come hang out with us and be part of the journey![/b]

💬 Join our Discord: https://discord.gg/VwhC9FKdvk

⭐ Wishlist ILA on Steam


Thank you once again for making this dream a reality. We’re so excited for what’s ahead, and we’re thrilled to have you with us on this magical ride! ✨

With love,
The Magic Rain Team 🩵

notes.title: Demo Available and Latest Updates!
notes.content:
Hi everyone! 💛

ILA is part of the Wholesome Steam Event, and starting tomorrow, it’ll also be featured in the Indie Arena Booth Event at Gamescom! [b]That means the demo will be available until August 26th!
[/b]

We've got some new updates based on your feedback in this demo! Here’s what’s new:

[h2]Latest Demo Updates:[/h2]

[h3]1. Improved Camera:[/h3]

- We've fixed the clipping issue.
- If an object or structure blocks Ila, voila! A little cutout appears so you can see clearly.
- We also added a distance view option and first-person mode for platforms. Plus, we gave the blur effect a nice polish!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45045030/40080619de5894c84144dec248437323610231c4.gif[/img]    
    

[h3]2. Expanded Ila’s Story:[/h3]

Now you can interact with objects and uncover more about what Ila is up to on this enchanted island.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45045030/2f3b4e5226f83c75782c186fbf3d5882a8aecb45.gif[/img]

[h3]3. Landmarks:[/h3]

It's now easier to find your way around the world. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45045030/8ddc2fb0a17a1edf68c46023c8fc772d4177e858.gif[/img]

[h3]4. Glide Enhancement:[/h3]

When you unlock the broom upgrade, you’ll be able to glide longer by holding down the glide button. No more sudden nosedives!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45045030/12ae6438c9df36a9213de58ab51052afc319d2d5.gif[/img]

[h3]5. Hat with a Life of Its Own![/h3]

We’ve added physics to Ila's hat and improved the existing ones. Now her hat moves like it has its own personality! (And we snuck in some extra art details here and there. 🤗
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45045030/07d79012f6b2ad5f870fa64f3c7162706da8a485.gif[/img]

We'll also be at Gamescom with a physical ILA booth in the Indie Arena Booth area![b] (HALL 10.2, F010G - E019)[/b] If you're around, stop by to say hi or try out the game with us. We’d love to see you!

Thanks a million for all your support 💜

And as always, any feedback is more than welcome 😄

Lots of Love, 

The Magic Rain Team

notes.title: Play the new demo ✨ and learn about our Kickstarter! 🚀
notes.content:
Hey there, fellow cozy gamers! 🌸

We’re Magic Rain, and we're beyond excited to introduce you to our magical little corner of the gaming world. If you love charming, wholesome games that make you feel all warm and fuzzy inside, you’re in the right place. Let us take you on a brief journey of how "ILA: A Frosty Glide" came to be, and why we think you’ll absolutely adore it.

[h3]A Magical Beginning ✨[/h3]
It all started during the Bigmode Game Jam last year, where we had just 19 days to bring our whimsical idea to life. We already had some fun illustrations about an early idea of ILA (she was originally called “Lila” but let’s leave that for another day), but that was it. Somehow, the concept of combining our passion for longboarding with the mystical allure of a witch’s broomstick resulted in the birth of ILA and her trusty skatebroom. Yes, you read that right—it's a skateboard and a broomstick all in one, because why not? It's cooler, it's magical, and it’s just plain fun (and let’s address the elephant in the room… flying on a broom is really uncomfortable. Not that we have tried, of course. Or… have we? 😬) 

[h3]Meet ILA 🧙‍♀️[/h3]
ILA is a young witch-in-training with big dreams and an even bigger heart. Armed with her skatebroom, she sets off to conquer the snowy peaks of a cozy and magical island, solving gravity-defying puzzles, collecting treasures, and customizing her look with stylish hats and capes. And the best part? You can now dive into this enchanting world yourself because the demo is live on Steam and can’t wait to hear your feedback! 🎮

[h3]Join Us on Kickstarter! 🚀[/h3]
But wait, there’s more! We’re also gearing up for a Kickstarter campaign, and we want you to be a part of it from the start. We’re cooking up some super fun and unique tiers for our backers, but we’d love to hear from you—our amazing community—about what kinds of rewards you'd like to see. Do you want exclusive in-game items? Perhaps some behind-the-scenes content or even a chance to design a character? We are really thinking ILA needs a cat, don’t you?😉🐈 Let us know!

[h3]Why We Need You 🌟[/h3]
Your feedback and support mean the world to us. We’re a small team with big dreams, and we genuinely believe that with your help, we can make "ILA: A Frosty Glide" an unforgettable experience. So, drop us a comment, share your thoughts, and let’s create something magical together.

[h3]Stay Connected 💌[/h3]
We’ll be sharing regular updates right here, so be sure to check back often. And don’t be shy—join our newsletter, follow us on social media, join our Discord, and become part of our cozy little community. We promise there’ll be plenty of laughs, sneak peeks, and maybe even a few skatebroom tricks along the way.


Thank you for being here with us on this magical journey. We can't wait to see where it takes us all.


With cozy vibes and magical high-fives,

The Magic Rain team 💛


P.S. Don’t forget to play the demo and let us know what you think. Happy gliding! 🧹💨
